name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRicci_add_decompose
statement:
theorem connectionRicci_add_decompose
    (G Q : I → I → I → ℝ)
    (H K L : I → I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci
        (fun M A B => G M A B + Q M A B)
        (fun R M A B => H R M A B + K R M A B + L R M A B) N P =
      AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci G H N P +
      AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci Q K N P +
      mixedConnectionRicci G Q L N P
proof:
:= by
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci mixedConnectionRicci
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add, add_mul]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.transformConnection_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem transformConnection_eq_bracket
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (M N P : I) :
    C.secondJet.transformConnection G M N P =
      ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M * C.connectionBracket G A N P
proof:
:= by
  unfold CoordinateChangeJet2.transformConnection connectionBracket
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformConnection
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A _
  rw [mul_add]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro B _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro D _
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.jac_transformContravariant2_contract
statement:
private theorem jac_transformContravariant2_contract
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv : I → I → ℝ) (A Q : I) :
    (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
      C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) =
      ∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2
  calc
    _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ M : I,
        C.affine.invJac B M * C.affine.jac M A *
          (C.affine.invJac D Q * gInv B D) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
            C.affine.jac M A *
              (C.affine.invJac B M * C.affine.invJac D Q * gInv B D) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ M : I,
            C.affine.jac M A *
              (C.affine.invJac B M * C.affine.invJac D Q * gInv B D) :=
          sum3_first_last _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          ring
    _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        (∑ M : I, C.affine.invJac B M * C.affine.jac M A) *
          (C.affine.invJac D Q * gInv B D) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro D _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, (if B = A then 1 else 0) *
        (C.affine.invJac D Q * gInv B D) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro D _
      rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
    _ = _ := by simp

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRaiseFactor_eq_jac_transformContravariant2
statement:
theorem connectionRaiseFactor_eq_jac_transformContravariant2
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv : I → I → ℝ) (A Q : I) :
    C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q =
      ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold connectionRaiseFactor
  exact (C.jac_transformContravariant2_contract gInv A Q).symm

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRaiseFactor_jac_metric_contract
statement:
theorem connectionRaiseFactor_jac_metric_contract
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (v : I → ℝ) (A : I) :
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
      (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
        v X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) = v A
proof:
:= by
  unfold connectionRaiseFactor
  calc
    _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
        (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
          (v X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Q _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro X _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ Q : I,
        (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
          (v X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ B : I,
            (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
              (v X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y) := sum4_last2_first _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ B : I,
        (∑ Q : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * C.affine.jac Q Y) *
          (gInv A B * v X * g X Y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro X _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Y _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Q _
      ring
    _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ B : I,
        (if B = Y then 1 else 0) * (gInv A B * v X * g X Y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro X _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Y _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
    _ = ∑ X : I, v X * (∑ Y : I, gInv A Y * g X Y) := by
      simp
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro X _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Y _
      ring
    _ = ∑ X : I, v X * (if A = X then 1 else 0) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro X _
      have hcontract :
          (∑ Y : I, gInv A Y * g X Y) = if A = X then 1 else 0 := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ Y : I, gInv A Y * g Y X := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro Y _
            rw [hg X Y]
          _ = _ := hInv A X
      rw [hcontract]
    _ = _ := by simp

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.sum4_first_last
statement:
private theorem sum4_first_last
    (f : I → I → I → I → ℝ) :
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d) =
      ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d, ∑ a, f a b c d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ b, ∑ a, ∑ c, ∑ d, f a b c d := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ a, ∑ d, f a b c d := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      exact Finset.sum_comm

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRaiseFactorJet_eq_productRule
statement:
theorem connectionRaiseFactorJet_eq_productRule
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (R A Q : I) :
    C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q =
      (∑ M : I, C.secondJet.second R M A *
        C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) +
      ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        C.transformInverseMetricJet gInv dg R M Q
proof:
:= by
  have hH :
      (∑ M : I, C.secondJet.second R M A *
        C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) =
        ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          (∑ M : I, C.affine.invJac X M *
            C.secondJet.second R M A) *
              (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) := by
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2
    calc
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.secondJet.second R M A *
            (C.affine.invJac X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ M : I,
          C.secondJet.second R M A *
            (C.affine.invJac X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) :=
        sum3_first_last _
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        ring
  have hKleft :
      (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        (∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.inverseJacobianJet R X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B)) =
        ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          (∑ M : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R X M *
            C.affine.jac M A) * (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ M : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B) :=
        sum3_first_last _
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        ring
  have hCancel :
      (∑ M : I, C.secondJet.second R M A *
        C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) +
      (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        (∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.inverseJacobianJet R X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B)) = 0 := by
    rw [hH, hKleft, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro X _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro B _
    rw [← add_mul]
    have hdef := C.inverseJacobianJet_jac_defining R X A
    rw [add_comm, hdef]
    ring
  have hKright :
      (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        (∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.invJac X M * C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B)) =
        ∑ B : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv A B := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.affine.invJac X M * C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ M : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.affine.invJac X M * C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B) :=
        sum3_first_last _
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          (∑ M : I, C.affine.invJac X M * C.affine.jac M A) *
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        ring
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I, (if X = A then 1 else 0) *
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hOld :
      (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        C.affine.transformContravariant2Jet
          (coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg) R M Q) =
        ∑ E : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
            coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B := by
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2Jet
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2
    calc
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac X M *
              C.affine.invJac B Q *
                coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro E _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        ring
      _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ M : I,
          C.affine.jac M A *
            (C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac X M *
              C.affine.invJac B Q *
                coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E X B) :=
        sum4_first_last _
      _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          (∑ M : I, C.affine.invJac X M * C.affine.jac M A) *
            (C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
              coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro E _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        ring
      _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
          (if X = A then 1 else 0) *
            (C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
              coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E X B) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro E _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
      _ = _ := by simp
  symm
  unfold transformInverseMetricJet connectionRaiseFactorJet
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  calc
    _ = ((∑ M : I, C.secondJet.second R M A *
          C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) +
        ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
          (∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
            C.inverseJacobianJet R X M * C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv X B)) +
        (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
          (∑ X : I, ∑ B : I,
            C.affine.invJac X M * C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv X B)) +
        ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
          C.affine.transformContravariant2Jet
            (coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg) R M Q := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hCancel, hKright, hOld]; ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.transformInverseMetricJet_eq_raiseProductRule
statement:
theorem transformInverseMetricJet_eq_raiseProductRule
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (R M Q : I) :
    C.transformInverseMetricJet gInv dg R M Q =
      (∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R A M *
        C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q) +
      ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q
proof:
:= by
  have hOld :
      (∑ E : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I,
        C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.invJac B Q *
          coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) =
      ∑ A : I, ∑ E : I, ∑ B : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
          coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro E _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    ring
  unfold transformInverseMetricJet connectionRaiseFactor
    connectionRaiseFactorJet
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2Jet
    AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  ring_nf at hOld ⊢
  rw [hOld]

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRaiseFactor_metricJacobianTerm_productRule
statement:
theorem connectionRaiseFactor_metricJacobianTerm_productRule
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hdg : ∀ R A B, dg R A B = dg R B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (R A N P : I) :
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
      C.secondJet.metricJacobianTerm g N P Q) +
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
      C.metricJacobianTermJet g dg R N P Q) =
      C.third R N P A
proof:
:= by
  let H : I → ℝ := fun X => C.secondJet.second N P X
  let T : I → ℝ := fun X => C.third R N P X
  have hThird :
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
          T X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) = T A :=
    C.connectionRaiseFactor_jac_metric_contract
      gInv g hg hInv T A
  have hHessian :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ B : I,
        C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv A B) *
          (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) +
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
          H X * C.secondJet.second R Q Y * g X Y)) = 0 := by
    have hLeft :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ B : I,
          C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv A B) *
            (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
              H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) =
        ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
          (gInv A B * H X * g X Y) *
            (∑ Q : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q *
              C.affine.jac Q Y) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv A B) *
              (H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ Q : I,
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R B Q * gInv A B) *
              (H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y) :=
            sum4_first_last _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          ring
    have hRight :
        (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            H X * C.secondJet.second R Q Y * g X Y)) =
        ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
          (gInv A B * H X * g X Y) *
            (∑ Q : I, C.affine.invJac B Q *
              C.secondJet.second R Q Y) := by
      unfold connectionRaiseFactor
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
              (H X * C.secondJet.second R Q Y * g X Y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ Q : I,
            (C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
              (H X * C.secondJet.second R Q Y * g X Y) :=
            sum4_first_last _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          ring
    rw [hLeft, hRight, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro B _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro X _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro Y _
    rw [← mul_add]
    rw [C.inverseJacobianJet_jac_defining R B Y]
    ring
  have hMetric :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ E : I, ∑ B : I,
        C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
          coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) *
          (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) +
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ D : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
          H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * C.affine.jac R D * dg D X Y)) = 0 := by
    have hContract (u v : I → ℝ) :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * u B) *
          (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * v Y)) =
        ∑ B : I, u B * v B := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ Y : I,
            (C.affine.invJac B Q * u B) *
              (C.affine.jac Q Y * v Y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ Y : I, ∑ Q : I,
            (C.affine.invJac B Q * u B) *
              (C.affine.jac Q Y * v Y) := sum3_first_last _
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ Y : I,
            (∑ Q : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * C.affine.jac Q Y) *
              (u B * v Y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          ring
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ Y : I, (if B = Y then 1 else 0) *
              (u B * v Y) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
        _ = _ := by simp
    have hLeft :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ E : I, ∑ B : I,
          C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac B Q *
            coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) *
            (∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
              H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) =
        ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I,
          C.affine.jac R E * H X *
            (∑ B : I, coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B *
              g X B) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I,

              ((∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q *
                  coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) *
                (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          ring
        _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Q : I,
            C.affine.jac R E * H X *
              ((∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q *
                  coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) *
                (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) :=
          sum3_first_last _
        _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ X : I,
            C.affine.jac R E * H X *
              (∑ B : I, coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B *
                g X B) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          calc
            _ = (C.affine.jac R E * H X) *
                (∑ Q : I,
                  (∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q *
                    coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B) *
                  (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * g X Y)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            _ = (C.affine.jac R E * H X) *
                (∑ B : I, coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B *
                  g X B) := by
              rw [hContract
                (fun B => coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A B)
                (fun Y => g X Y)]
    have hRight :
        (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          (∑ D : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Y : I,
            H X * C.affine.jac Q Y * C.affine.jac R D * dg D X Y)) =
        ∑ D : I, ∑ X : I,
          C.affine.jac R D * H X *
            (∑ B : I, gInv A B * dg D X B) := by
      unfold connectionRaiseFactor
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ X : I,
            C.affine.jac R D * H X *
              ((∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
                (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * dg D X Y)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Y _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          ring
        _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ Q : I,
            C.affine.jac R D * H X *
              ((∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
                (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * dg D X Y)) :=
          sum3_first_last _
        _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ X : I,
            C.affine.jac R D * H X *
              (∑ B : I, gInv A B * dg D X B) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          calc
            _ = (C.affine.jac R D * H X) *
                (∑ Q : I, (∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
                  (∑ Y : I, C.affine.jac Q Y * dg D X Y)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            _ = (C.affine.jac R D * H X) *
                (∑ B : I, gInv A B * dg D X B) := by
              rw [hContract (fun B => gInv A B) (fun Y => dg D X Y)]
    rw [hLeft, hRight]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro E _

    CoordinateChangeJet2.metricJacobianTerm

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRaiseFactor_affineFirstKind_productRule
statement:
theorem connectionRaiseFactor_affineFirstKind_productRule
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (R A N P : I) :
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
      C.affine.transformCovariant3
        (coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg) Q N P) +
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
      C.affineChristoffelFirstKindJet dg ddg R Q N P) =
      (∑ E : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
          coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg E A B D) +
      (∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.secondJet.second R N B * C.affine.jac P D *
          coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D) +
      ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac N B * C.secondJet.second R P D *
          coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D
proof:
:= by
  let F : I → I → I → ℝ := coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg
  let FJ : I → I → I → I → ℝ :=
    fun E => coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet ddg E
  have hContract (v w : I → ℝ) :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
        (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * w U)) =
      ∑ X : I, v X * w X := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I,
          (C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * w U) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ Q : I,
          (C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * w U) := sum3_first_last _
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I,
          (∑ Q : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * C.affine.jac Q U) *
            (v X * w U) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        ring
      _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, (if X = U then 1 else 0) *
            (v X * w U) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro X _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hDerivativeContract (v w : I → ℝ) :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I,
        C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * v X) *
          (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * w U)) +
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
        (∑ U : I, C.secondJet.second R Q U * w U)) = 0 := by
    have hLeft :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I,
          C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * v X) *
            (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * w U)) =
        ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, (v X * w U) *
          (∑ Q : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q *
            C.affine.jac Q U) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I,
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * v X) *
              (C.affine.jac Q U * w U) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ Q : I,
            (C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * v X) *
              (C.affine.jac Q U * w U) := sum3_first_last _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro U _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          ring
    have hRight :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
          (∑ U : I, C.secondJet.second R Q U * w U)) =
        ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, (v X * w U) *
          (∑ Q : I, C.affine.invJac X Q *
            C.secondJet.second R Q U) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I,
            (C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
              (C.secondJet.second R Q U * w U) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ X : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ Q : I,
            (C.affine.invJac X Q * v X) *
              (C.secondJet.second R Q U * w U) := sum3_first_last _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro U _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          ring
    rw [hLeft, hRight, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro X _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro U _
    rw [← mul_add]
    rw [C.inverseJacobianJet_jac_defining R X U]
    ring
  have hFactorSum₂ (c d : ℝ) (f k : I → ℝ)
      (h : ∀ U, c * d * f U = k U) :
      c * (d * (∑ U : I, f U)) = ∑ U : I, k U := by
    calc
      _ = (c * d) * (∑ U : I, f U) := by ring
      _ = ∑ U : I, (c * d) * f U := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        exact h U
  have hRaise (V : I → I → ℝ) (K : I → I → I → ℝ)
      (A' N' P' : I) :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * V A' X) *
        C.affine.transformCovariant3 K Q N' P') =
      ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac N' B * C.affine.jac P' D *
          (∑ X : I, V A' X * K X B D) := by
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformCovariant3
    calc
      _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * V A' X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N' B *
              C.affine.jac P' D * K U B D) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * V A' X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N' B *
              C.affine.jac P' D * K U B D) := sum4_last2_first _
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac N' B * C.affine.jac P' D *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * V A' X) *
              (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * K U B D)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        symm
        conv_lhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        apply hFactorSum₂
        intro U
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        rw [hContract (fun X => V A' X) (fun U => K U B D)]
  have hCancel :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I,
        C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * gInv A X) *
          C.affine.transformCovariant3 F Q N P) +
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.secondJet.second R Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
            C.affine.jac P D * F U B D)) = 0 := by
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformCovariant3 connectionRaiseFactor
    have hLeft :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I,
          C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * gInv A X) *
            (∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
              C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
                C.affine.jac P D * F U B D)) =
        ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I,
              C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * gInv A X) *
                (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * F U B D)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
            (∑ X : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * gInv A X) *
              (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
                C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro U _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I,
            (∑ X : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R X Q * gInv A X) *
              (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
                C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := sum4_last2_first _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          symm
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          apply hFactorSum₂
          intro U
          ring
    have hRight :
        (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
          (∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
            C.secondJet.second R Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
              C.affine.jac P D * F U B D)) =
        ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
              (∑ U : I, C.secondJet.second R Q U * F U B D)) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
            (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
              (C.secondJet.second R Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
                C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro U _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I,
            (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
              (C.secondJet.second R Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
                C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := sum4_last2_first _
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          symm
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro Q _
          apply hFactorSum₂
          intro U
          ring
    rw [hLeft, hRight, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro B _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro D _
    have hd := hDerivativeContract
      (fun X => gInv A X) (fun U => F U B D)
    linear_combination (C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D) * hd
  have hOld :
      (∑ Q : I, (∑ E : I, ∑ X : I,
        C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.invJac X Q *
          coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A X) *
            C.affine.transformCovariant3 F Q N P) +
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        C.affine.transformCovariant4 FJ R Q N P) =
      ∑ E : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *

    have hInvPart :

      calc

          intro Q _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro X _
          ring
        _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ Q : I,
            C.affine.jac R E *
              ((∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q *
                coordinateInverseMetricJet gInv dg E A X) *
                  C.affine.transformCovariant3 F Q N P) := Finset.sum_comm
        _ = ∑ E : I, C.affine.jac R E *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q *

            F A N P]

          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

    have hJetPart :
        (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          C.affine.transformCovariant4 FJ R Q N P) =
        ∑ E : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            (∑ X : I, gInv A X * FJ E X B D) := by
      unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformCovariant4
      calc
        _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ E : I,
            C.affine.jac R E *

          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _

            C.affine.jac R E *

            (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *

          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ E : I, C.affine.jac R E *
            (∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
              C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
                (∑ X : I, gInv A X * FJ E X B D)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _

        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro B _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _

    rw [hInvPart, hJetPart, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro E _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro D _
    dsimp [F, FJ]
    unfold coordinateChristoffelJet
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  have hLowerN :
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac Q U * C.secondJet.second R N B *
            C.affine.jac P D * F U B D)) =
      ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.secondJet.second R N B * C.affine.jac P D *
          coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D := by
    unfold connectionRaiseFactor
    calc
      _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.secondJet.second R N B *
              C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.secondJet.second R N B *
              C.affine.jac P D * F U B D) := sum4_last2_first _
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.secondJet.second R N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
              (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * F U B D)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        symm
        conv_lhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        apply hFactorSum₂
        intro U
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        rw [hContract (fun X => gInv A X) (fun U => F U B D)]
        dsimp [F]
        rfl
  have hLowerP :
      (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
        (∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
            C.secondJet.second R P D * F U B D)) =
      ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac N B * C.secondJet.second R P D *
          coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D := by
    unfold connectionRaiseFactor
    calc
      _ = ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
              C.secondJet.second R P D * F U B D) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro U _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I, ∑ Q : I, ∑ U : I,
          (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
            (C.affine.jac Q U * C.affine.jac N B *
              C.secondJet.second R P D * F U B D) := sum4_last2_first _
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac N B * C.secondJet.second R P D *
            (∑ Q : I, (∑ X : I, C.affine.invJac X Q * gInv A X) *
              (∑ U : I, C.affine.jac Q U * F U B D)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        symm
        conv_lhs => rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro Q _
        apply hFactorSum₂
        intro U
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro D _
        rw [hContract (fun X => gInv A X) (fun U => F U B D)]
        dsimp [F]
        rfl
  unfold connectionRaiseFactorJet affineChristoffelFirstKindJet
  dsimp [F, FJ] at hCancel hOld hLowerN hLowerP ⊢
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  linear_combination hCancel + hOld + hLowerN + hLowerP

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.transformedFirstKind_raise_eq_connectionBracket
statement:
theorem transformedFirstKind_raise_eq_connectionBracket
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (A N P : I) :
    (∑ Q : I, (∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B Q * gInv A B) *
      coordinateChristoffelFirstKind
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) Q N P) =
      C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) A N P
proof:
:= by
  let dg' := C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg
  have hconn (M : I) :
      coordinateChristoffel (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
          dg' M N P =
        C.secondJet.transformConnection (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
          M N P := by
    exact C.secondJet.coordinateChristoffel_transformConnection
      gInv g dg hg hInv M N P
  calc
    _ = ∑ Q : I,
        (∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
          C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q) *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Q _
      rw [C.jac_transformContravariant2_contract gInv A Q]
    _ = ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        coordinateChristoffel (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
          dg' M N P := by
      unfold coordinateChristoffel
      symm
      calc
        _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ E : I,
            C.affine.jac M A *
              (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M E *
                coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' E N P) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ E : I, ∑ M : I,
            C.affine.jac M A *
              (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M E *
                coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' E N P) :=
          Finset.sum_comm
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          ring
    _ = ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
        C.secondJet.transformConnection (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
          M N P := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro M _
      rw [hconn]
    _ = _ := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ M : I, C.affine.jac M A *
            (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E M *
              C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) E N P) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          rw [C.transformConnection_eq_bracket]
        _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ E : I,
            C.affine.jac M A * C.affine.invJac E M *
              C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) E N P := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          ring
        _ = ∑ E : I, (∑ M : I,
            C.affine.invJac E M * C.affine.jac M A) *
              C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) E N P := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro M _
          ring
        _ = ∑ E : I, (if E = A then 1 else 0) *
              C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) E N P := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro E _
          rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
        _ = _ := by simp

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.transformedFirstKindJet_raise_eq_connectionBracketJet
statement:
theorem transformedFirstKindJet_raise_eq_connectionBracketJet
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hdg : ∀ R A B, dg R A B = dg R B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (R A N P : I) :
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
      coordinateChristoffelFirstKind
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) Q N P) +
    (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
      coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet
        (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) R Q N P) =
      C.connectionBracketJet (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
        (coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg) R A N P
proof:
:= by
  have hFirst (Q : I) :
      coordinateChristoffelFirstKind
          (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) Q N P =
        C.affine.transformCovariant3
            (coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg) Q N P +
          C.secondJet.metricJacobianTerm g N P Q :=
    C.secondJet.coordinateChristoffelFirstKind_transformMetricJet1
      g dg Q N P
  have hJet (Q : I) :
      coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet
          (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) R Q N P =
        C.affineChristoffelFirstKindJet dg ddg R Q N P +
          C.metricJacobianTermJet g dg R N P Q :=
    C.coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet_transformMetricJet2_explicit
      g dg ddg R Q N P
  calc
    _ = ((∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
          C.affine.transformCovariant3
            (coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg) Q N P) +
        ∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          C.affineChristoffelFirstKindJet dg ddg R Q N P) +
      ((∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
          C.secondJet.metricJacobianTerm g N P Q) +
        ∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          C.metricJacobianTermJet g dg R N P Q) := by
      simp_rw [hFirst, hJet]
      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    _ = ((∑ E : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac R E * C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg E A B D) +
        (∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.secondJet.second R N B * C.affine.jac P D *
            coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D) +
        ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
          C.affine.jac N B * C.secondJet.second R P D *
            coordinateChristoffel gInv dg A B D) +
      C.third R N P A := by
      rw [C.connectionRaiseFactor_affineFirstKind_productRule
        gInv dg ddg R A N P]
      rw [C.connectionRaiseFactor_metricJacobianTerm_productRule
        gInv g dg hg hdg hInv R A N P]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.affineTransformConnection_eq_bracket
statement:
theorem affineTransformConnection_eq_bracket
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (M N P : I) :
    C.affine.transformConnection G M N P =
      ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P
proof:
:= by
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformConnection affineConnectionBracket
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro A _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro B _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro D _
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.jacCovector_invContravector_contract
statement:
private theorem jacCovector_invContravector_contract
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (u v : I → ℝ) :
    (∑ S : I, (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac S D * u D) *
      (∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A S * v A)) =
      ∑ D : I, u D * v D
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.jac S D * u D * (C.affine.invJac A S * v A) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ S : I,
        C.affine.invJac A S * C.affine.jac S D * (u D * v A) := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
            C.affine.jac S D * u D *
              (C.affine.invJac A S * v A) := sum3_last_first _
        _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ S : I,
            C.affine.jac S D * u D *
              (C.affine.invJac A S * v A) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          exact Finset.sum_comm
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro D _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro A _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro S _
          ring
    _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ A : I,
        (∑ S : I, C.affine.invJac A S * C.affine.jac S D) *
          (u D * v A) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro D _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ D : I, ∑ A : I, (if A = D then 1 else 0) *
        (u D * v A) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro D _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [C.affine.inv_jac_contract]
    _ = _ := by simp

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.affineConnection_pureContract
statement:
private theorem affineConnection_pureContract
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ)
    (M N R P : I) :
    (∑ S : I, C.affine.transformConnection G M N S *
      C.pureCoordinateConnection S R P) =
      ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac N B * G A B D *
          C.secondJet.second R P D
proof:
:= by
  have hbracket (A : I) :
      (∑ S : I, C.affineConnectionBracket G A N S *
        (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
          C.secondJet.second R P E)) =
      ∑ B : I, C.affine.jac N B *
        (∑ S : I, (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E)) := by
    unfold affineConnectionBracket
    calc
      _ = ∑ S : I, ∑ B : I,
          (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I,
          (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E) := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        calc
          _ = (∑ D : I,
              C.affine.jac N B * C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
              (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
                C.secondJet.second R P E) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          _ = (C.affine.jac N B *
              ∑ D : I, C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
              (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
                C.secondJet.second R P E) := by
            congr 1
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro D _
            ring
          _ = _ := by ring
  calc
    _ = ∑ S : I,
        (∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          C.affineConnectionBracket G A N S) *
        (∑ D : I, C.affine.invJac D S *
          C.secondJet.second R P D) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro S _
      rw [C.affineTransformConnection_eq_bracket]
      rfl
    _ = ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N S *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro S _
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = ∑ A : I, ∑ S : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N S *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E) := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        (∑ S : I, C.affineConnectionBracket G A N S *
          (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
            C.secondJet.second R P E)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro S _
      ring
    _ = ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        (∑ B : I, C.affine.jac N B *
          (∑ S : I, (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
            (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
              C.secondJet.second R P E))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [hbracket A]
    _ = ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        C.affine.jac N B *
          (∑ S : I, (∑ D : I, C.affine.jac S D * G A B D) *
            (∑ E : I, C.affine.invJac E S *
              C.secondJet.second R P E)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      ring
    _ = ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        C.affine.jac N B *
          (∑ D : I, G A B D * C.secondJet.second R P D) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [C.jacCovector_invContravector_contract]
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro B _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro D _
      ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.mixedInverseTrace_add_tracePureAffine
statement:
private theorem mixedInverseTrace_add_tracePureAffine
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet M A M *
      C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P) +
    (∑ S : I, (∑ M : I, C.pureCoordinateConnection M M S) *
      C.affine.transformConnection G S N P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinv :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet M A M *
        C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P) =
      -∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
        C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B *
          C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P := by
    unfold inverseJacobianJet
    calc
      _ = -∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B *
            C.affine.invJac A S) * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P := by
        simp only [neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = _ := by
        apply congrArg Neg.neg
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        exact sum3_first_last _
  have hquad :
      (∑ S : I, (∑ M : I, C.pureCoordinateConnection M M S) *
        C.affine.transformConnection G S N P) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
        C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B *
          C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ S : I,
          (∑ M : I, ∑ B : I,
            C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B) *
          (∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A S *
            C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        rw [C.affineTransformConnection_eq_bracket]
        rfl
      _ = ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B) *
            (C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second M S B) *
            (C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A N P) :=
        sum4_last2_first _
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        ring
  rw [hinv, hquad]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.mixedInverseCross_add_pureAffineCross
statement:
private theorem mixedInverseCross_add_pureAffineCross
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet N A M *
      C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P) +
    (∑ M : I, ∑ S : I, C.pureCoordinateConnection M N S *
      C.affine.transformConnection G S M P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinv :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet N A M *
        C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P) =
      -∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
        C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B *
          C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P := by
    unfold inverseJacobianJet
    calc
      _ = -∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B *
            C.affine.invJac A S) * C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P := by
        simp only [neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = _ := by
        apply congrArg Neg.neg
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        exact sum3_first_last _
  have hquad :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ S : I, C.pureCoordinateConnection M N S *
        C.affine.transformConnection G S M P) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
        C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B *
          C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ S : I,
          (∑ B : I, C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B) *
          (∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A S *
            C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        rw [C.affineTransformConnection_eq_bracket]
        rfl
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B) *
            (C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P) := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ S : I, ∑ A : I,
          (C.affine.invJac B M * C.secondJet.second N S B) *
            (C.affine.invJac A S * C.affineConnectionBracket G A M P) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        exact sum3_last_first _
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro B _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        ring
  rw [hinv, hquad]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.jacobianMixedTrace_cancels
statement:
private theorem jacobianMixedTrace_cancels
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
      C.jacobianConnectionBracketJet G M A N P) -
    (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
      C.jacobianConnectionBracketJet G N A M P) +
    (∑ S : I, (∑ M : I, C.affine.transformConnection G M M S) *
      C.pureCoordinateConnection S N P) -
    (∑ M : I, ∑ S : I, C.affine.transformConnection G M N S *
      C.pureCoordinateConnection S M P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htrace :
      (∑ S : I, (∑ M : I, C.affine.transformConnection G M M S) *
        C.pureCoordinateConnection S N P) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac M B * G A B D *
          C.secondJet.second N P D := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ S : I, ∑ M : I,
          C.affine.transformConnection G M M S *
            C.pureCoordinateConnection S N P := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro S _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ M : I, ∑ S : I,
          C.affine.transformConnection G M M S *
            C.pureCoordinateConnection S N P := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro M _
        exact C.affineConnection_pureContract G M M N P
  have hcross :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ S : I, C.affine.transformConnection G M N S *
        C.pureCoordinateConnection S M P) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac N B * G A B D *
          C.secondJet.second M P D := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    exact C.affineConnection_pureContract G M N M P
  have hsym :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * (C.secondJet.second M N B *
          C.affine.jac P D * G A B D)) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * (C.secondJet.second N M B *
          C.affine.jac P D * G A B D) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro D _
    rw [C.secondJet.second_symm M N B]
  have hT2 :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * (C.affine.jac N B *
          C.secondJet.second M P D * G A B D)) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac N B * G A B D *
          C.secondJet.second M P D := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro D _
    ring
  have hU2 :
      (∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * (C.affine.jac M B *
          C.secondJet.second N P D * G A B D)) =
      ∑ M : I, ∑ A : I, ∑ B : I, ∑ D : I,
        C.affine.invJac A M * C.affine.jac M B * G A B D *
          C.secondJet.second N P D := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro M _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro D _
    ring
  rw [htrace, hcross]
  unfold jacobianConnectionBracketJet
  simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hsym, hT2, hU2]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.mixedConnectionRicci_zero
statement:
theorem mixedConnectionRicci_zero
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    mixedConnectionRicci
      (C.affine.transformConnection G) C.pureCoordinateConnection
      (C.mixedCoordinateConnectionJet G) N P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hInvTrace := C.mixedInverseTrace_add_tracePureAffine G N P
  have hInvCross := C.mixedInverseCross_add_pureAffineCross G N P
  have hJac := C.jacobianMixedTrace_cancels G N P
  unfold mixedConnectionRicci mixedCoordinateConnectionJet
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  linear_combination hInvTrace - hInvCross + hJac

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRicci_pureCoordinate_zero
statement:
theorem connectionRicci_pureCoordinate_zero
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (N P : I) :
    AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci
      (C.secondJet.transformConnection (fun _ _ _ => 0))
      (C.transformConnectionJet (fun _ _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0))
      N P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hG :
      C.secondJet.transformConnection (fun _ _ _ => 0) =
        C.pureCoordinateConnection := by
    funext M N' P'
    exact C.transformConnection_zero M N' P'
  have hH :
      C.transformConnectionJet (fun _ _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0) =
        C.pureCoordinateConnectionJet := by
    funext R M N' P'
    exact C.transformConnectionJet_zero R M N' P'
  rw [hG, hH]
  unfold AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci pureCoordinateConnectionJet
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have htrace := C.pureCoordinate_inverseTrace_add_traceProduct N P
  have hcross := C.pureCoordinate_inverseCross_add_crossProduct N P
  have hthird := C.pureCoordinate_thirdTrace_eq N P
  rw [hthird]
  linear_combination htrace - hcross

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRicci_transform_eq_affine_add_mixed
statement:
theorem connectionRicci_transform_eq_affine_add_mixed
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ)
    (H : I → I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci
        (C.secondJet.transformConnection G)
        (C.transformConnectionJet G H) N P =
      C.affine.transformCovariant2
          (AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci G H) N P +
        mixedConnectionRicci
          (C.affine.transformConnection G) C.pureCoordinateConnection
          (C.mixedCoordinateConnectionJet G) N P
proof:
:= by
  have hG : C.secondJet.transformConnection G =
      fun M N' P' => C.affine.transformConnection G M N' P' +
        C.pureCoordinateConnection M N' P' := by
    funext M N' P'
    exact C.transformConnection_decompose G M N' P'
  have hH : C.transformConnectionJet G H =
      fun R M N' P' => C.affine.transformConnectionJet H R M N' P' +
        C.pureCoordinateConnectionJet R M N' P' +
        C.mixedCoordinateConnectionJet G R M N' P' := by
    funext R M N' P'
    exact C.transformConnectionJet_decompose G H R M N' P'
  have hpure :
      AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci C.pureCoordinateConnection
        C.pureCoordinateConnectionJet N P = 0 := by
    have hzero := C.connectionRicci_pureCoordinate_zero N P
    have hzG :
        C.secondJet.transformConnection (fun _ _ _ => 0) =
          C.pureCoordinateConnection := by
      funext M N' P'
      exact C.transformConnection_zero M N' P'
    have hzH :
        C.transformConnectionJet (fun _ _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0) =
          C.pureCoordinateConnectionJet := by
      funext R M N' P'
      exact C.transformConnectionJet_zero R M N' P'
    rw [hzG, hzH] at hzero
    exact hzero
  rw [hG, hH]
  rw [connectionRicci_add_decompose]
  rw [C.affine.connectionRicci_transform]
  rw [hpure]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRicci_transform
statement:
theorem connectionRicci_transform
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ)
    (H : I → I → I → I → ℝ) (N P : I) :
    AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci
        (C.secondJet.transformConnection G)
        (C.transformConnectionJet G H) N P =
      C.affine.transformCovariant2
        (AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci G H) N P
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.connectionRicci_transform_eq_affine_add_mixed]
  rw [C.mixedConnectionRicci_zero]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.connectionRicciFlat_transform_iff
statement:
theorem connectionRicciFlat_transform_iff
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (G : I → I → I → ℝ)
    (H : I → I → I → I → ℝ) :
    (∀ N P, AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci
        (C.secondJet.transformConnection G)
        (C.transformConnectionJet G H) N P = 0) ↔
      ∀ N P, AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci G H N P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := C.affine.transformCovariant2_zero_iff
    (AffineCoordinateChange.connectionRicci G H)
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hzero.mp
    intro N P
    rw [← C.connectionRicci_transform]
    exact h N P
  · intro h N P
    rw [C.connectionRicci_transform]
    exact hzero.mpr h N P

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.coordinateChristoffelJet_transformConnectionJet
statement:
theorem coordinateChristoffelJet_transformConnectionJet
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hgInv : ∀ A B, gInv A B = gInv B A)
    (hdg : ∀ R A B, dg R A B = dg R B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (R M N P : I) :
    coordinateChristoffelJet
        (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg)
        (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) R M N P =
      C.transformConnectionJet (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
        (coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg) R M N P
proof:
:= by
  let dg' := C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg
  let ddg' := C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg
  have hInverseJet (Q : I) :
      coordinateInverseMetricJet
          (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv) dg' R M Q =
        (∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R A M *
          C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q) +
        ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q := by
    rw [C.coordinateInverseMetricJet_transformMetricJet1
      gInv g dg hg hgInv hInv R M Q]
    exact C.transformInverseMetricJet_eq_raiseProductRule gInv dg R M Q
  have hInverse (Q : I) :
      C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q =
        ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q := by
    unfold AffineCoordinateChange.transformContravariant2
      connectionRaiseFactor
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro B _
    ring
  have hFirst :
      (∑ Q : I,
        coordinateInverseMetricJet
            (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv) dg' R M Q *
          coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P) =
        (∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R A M *
          (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P)) +
        ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P) := by
    simp_rw [hInverseJet]
    simp only [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Q _
      ring
    · rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro A _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro Q _
      ring
  have hSecond :
      (∑ Q : I, C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q *
        coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet ddg' R Q N P) =
      ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
        (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
          coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet ddg' R Q N P) := by
    simp_rw [hInverse]
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro Q _
    ring
  have hProduct :
      coordinateChristoffelJet
          (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv) dg' ddg' R M N P =
        (∑ Q : I,
          coordinateInverseMetricJet
              (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv) dg' R M Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P) +
        (∑ Q : I, C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv M Q *
          coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet ddg' R Q N P) := by
    unfold coordinateChristoffelJet
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hProduct, hFirst, hSecond]
  calc
    _ = (∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R A M *
          (∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P)) +
        ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          ((∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactorJet gInv dg R A Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKind dg' Q N P) +
          ∑ Q : I, C.connectionRaiseFactor gInv A Q *
            coordinateChristoffelFirstKindJet ddg' R Q N P) := by
      simp only [mul_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    _ = (∑ A : I, C.inverseJacobianJet R A M *
          C.connectionBracket (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) A N P) +
        ∑ A : I, C.affine.invJac A M *
          C.connectionBracketJet (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
            (coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg) R A N P := by
      apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        dsimp [dg']
        unfold connectionRaiseFactor
        rw [C.transformedFirstKind_raise_eq_connectionBracket
          gInv g dg hg hInv A N P]
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro A _
        dsimp [dg', ddg']
        rw [C.transformedFirstKindJet_raise_eq_connectionBracketJet
          gInv g dg ddg hg hdg hInv R A N P]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.coordinateRicci_transform_of_christoffelJet
statement:
theorem coordinateRicci_transform_of_christoffelJet
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg ddg' : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (hJet : coordinateChristoffelJet
        (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) ddg' =
      C.transformConnectionJet (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg)
        (coordinateChristoffelJet gInv dg ddg))
    (N P : I) :
    coordinateRicci (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) ddg' N P =
      C.affine.transformCovariant2 (coordinateRicci gInv dg ddg) N P
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineCoordinateChange.coordinateRicci_eq_connectionRicci]
  have hG :
      coordinateChristoffel (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
          (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg) =
        C.secondJet.transformConnection (coordinateChristoffel gInv dg) := by
    funext M N' P'
    exact C.secondJet.coordinateChristoffel_transformConnection
      gInv g dg hg hInv M N' P'
  rw [hG, hJet]
  rw [C.connectionRicci_transform]
  rfl

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.coordinateRicci_transform
statement:
theorem coordinateRicci_transform
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hgInv : ∀ A B, gInv A B = gInv B A)
    (hdg : ∀ R A B, dg R A B = dg R B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0)
    (N P : I) :
    coordinateRicci (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg)
        (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) N P =
      C.affine.transformCovariant2 (coordinateRicci gInv dg ddg) N P
proof:
:= by
  apply C.coordinateRicci_transform_of_christoffelJet
    gInv g dg ddg (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) hg hInv
  · funext R M N' P'
    exact C.coordinateChristoffelJet_transformConnectionJet
      gInv g dg ddg hg hgInv hdg hInv R M N' P'

name: RainichKaluza.CoordinateChangeJet3.coordinateRicciFlat_transform_iff
statement:
theorem coordinateRicciFlat_transform_iff
    (C : CoordinateChangeJet3 I) (gInv g : I → I → ℝ)
    (dg : CoordinateMetricJet1 I) (ddg : CoordinateMetricJet2 I)
    (hg : ∀ A B, g A B = g B A)
    (hgInv : ∀ A B, gInv A B = gInv B A)
    (hdg : ∀ R A B, dg R A B = dg R B A)
    (hInv : ∀ A B, (∑ D : I, gInv A D * g D B) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0) :
    (∀ N P, coordinateRicci (C.affine.transformContravariant2 gInv)
        (C.secondJet.transformMetricJet1 g dg)
        (C.transformMetricJet2 g dg ddg) N P = 0) ↔
      ∀ N P, coordinateRicci gInv dg ddg N P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := C.affine.transformCovariant2_zero_iff
    (coordinateRicci gInv dg ddg)
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply hzero.mp
    intro N P
    rw [← C.coordinateRicci_transform
      gInv g dg ddg hg hgInv hdg hInv]
    exact h N P
  · intro h N P
    rw [C.coordinateRicci_transform
      gInv g dg ddg hg hgInv hdg hInv]
    exact hzero.mpr h N P

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_transpose
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_transpose (E B : ℝ) :
    (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B)ᵀ = -canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [canonicalMaxwellTwoForm, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_invariant
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_invariant (E B : ℝ) :
    twoFormQuadraticInvariant (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B) =
      2 * (B ^ 2 - E ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [twoFormQuadraticInvariant, raiseBothIndices, canonicalMaxwellTwoForm,
    minkowskiSign, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellStressMixed_canonical
statement:
theorem maxwellStressMixed_canonical (E B : ℝ) :
    maxwellStressMixed (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B) =
      canonicalMaxwellStress E B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [maxwellStressMixed, canonicalMaxwellStress,
      canonicalStressMagnitude, twoFormQuadraticInvariant, raiseBothIndices,
      canonicalMaxwellTwoForm, minkowskiSign, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellStress_sq
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellStress_sq (E B : ℝ) :
    canonicalMaxwellStress E B * canonicalMaxwellStress E B =
      canonicalStressMagnitude E B ^ 2 •
        (1 : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, canonicalMaxwellStress, canonicalStressMagnitude,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellStress_trace
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellStress_trace (E B : ℝ) :
    Matrix.trace (canonicalMaxwellStress E B) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, canonicalMaxwellStress, canonicalStressMagnitude,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalMaxwellStress_energy_nonneg
statement:
theorem canonicalMaxwellStress_energy_nonneg (E B : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ -canonicalMaxwellStress E B 0 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [canonicalMaxwellStress, canonicalStressMagnitude]
  positivity

name: RainichKaluza.exists_canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_of_pos
statement:
theorem exists_canonicalMaxwellTwoForm_of_pos
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    maxwellStressMixed
      (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm (Real.sqrt (2 * q)) 0) =
        canonicalMaxwellResidual q
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxwellStressMixed_canonical]
  have harg : 0 ≤ 2 * q := by positivity
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (2 * q)) ^ 2 = 2 * q := Real.sq_sqrt harg
  have hrho : canonicalStressMagnitude (Real.sqrt (2 * q)) 0 = q := by
    unfold canonicalStressMagnitude
    rw [hsqrt]
    ring
  unfold canonicalMaxwellStress
  rw [hrho]
  rfl

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalHodgeStar_sq
statement:
theorem canonicalHodgeStar_sq (E B : ℝ) :
    canonicalHodgeStar (-B) E = -canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [canonicalHodgeStar, canonicalMaxwellTwoForm]

name: RainichKaluza.canonicalTwoForm_duality
statement:
theorem canonicalTwoForm_duality
    (p : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ) :
    canonicalMaxwellTwoForm (dualityElectric p E B)
        (dualityMagnetic p E B) =
      p.c • canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B +
        p.s • canonicalHodgeStar E B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [dualityElectric, dualityMagnetic, canonicalHodgeStar,
      canonicalMaxwellTwoForm] <;> ring

name: RainichKaluza.maxwellStressMixed_canonical_duality
statement:
theorem maxwellStressMixed_canonical_duality
    (p : DualityParameter) (E B : ℝ) :
    maxwellStressMixed
        (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm (dualityElectric p E B)
          (dualityMagnetic p E B)) =
      maxwellStressMixed (canonicalMaxwellTwoForm E B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxwellStressMixed_canonical, maxwellStressMixed_canonical]
  have hmag :
      canonicalStressMagnitude (dualityElectric p E B)
          (dualityMagnetic p E B) = canonicalStressMagnitude E B := by
    change canonicalMaxwellMagnitude (dualityElectric p E B)
        (dualityMagnetic p E B) / 2 = canonicalMaxwellMagnitude E B / 2
    rw [canonicalMaxwellMagnitude_duality]
  unfold canonicalMaxwellStress
  rw [hmag]

theorem exists_scalarPotential_of_closed
